scope: Android reference CSC diagnostic backend only; no VO/lib transaction hook or device run
ssboBindingPolicy: Arm and draw both reject any nonzero indexed binding; no existing base/range is displaced. Original zero indexed binding and generic binding are restored.
ownerApi: Pure EGL display/context/draw/read surface and capture id/generation/active status check, no GL or make-current; FAILED current may cleanup
ownerRestorePolicy: One attempt per armed capture on recorded Android VO owner thread; query live current handles then make current once; capture stays FAILED, no swap/retry; no runtime EGL success/failure injection yet
